topic_name: The Party System of the Republic of Kazakhstan

321.question: In Kazakhstan, as of November 9, 2026, a citizen has the right to belong at the same time...

options.A: To two parties, with the consent of their leaderships
options.B: To any number of registered parties
options.D: To one parliamentary and one non-parliamentary party
options.E: To two parties with different program goals

322.question: The minimum age for a citizen of Kazakhstan to join a political party as of November 9, 2026 is...

323.question: Party membership in Kazakhstan as of November 9, 2026:

options.A: Collective, by decision of a work collective
options.E: Simultaneous in several parties where they are ideologically close

324.question: The territorial representation required of the initiative group for creating a party (at least 700 citizens) as of November 9, 2026:

options.A: Half of the regions, not counting the capital
options.B: Any one region, provided a majority of its districts are represented
options.C: All administrative districts of the country
options.D: Only two cities of republican significance
options.E: Two thirds of the regions, the cities of republican significance and the capital

325.question: The minimum total membership of a party for state registration in Kazakhstan as of November 9, 2026 is...

326.question: The requirement for the minimum size of each regional branch of a party being registered in Kazakhstan as of November 9, 2026 is...

327.question: As of November 9, 2026, the creation of parties on the basis of which affiliation of citizens is not permitted in Kazakhstan?

options.C: Supporters of a general direction of social reform
options.D: Supporters of a particular economic program

328.question: A Kazakhstani citizen's party affiliation as of November 9, 2026...

options.A: Exempts him from compliance with court decisions
options.B: Gives him a preferential right to a public office
options.C: Replaces the citizenship requirement in elections
options.D: Cannot in itself serve as a ground for restricting his rights
options.E: Must be stated in every appeal to a state body

329.question: Persons who may not belong to a party in Kazakhstan as of November 9, 2026, include...

options.A: Members of the Central Election Commission
options.B: University lecturers by virtue of the mere fact of teaching
options.D: Researchers by virtue of the mere fact of doing research

330.question: An initiative group of 700 people claims that it has thereby met the numerical threshold for the state registration of a party in Kazakhstan as of November 9, 2026. What is the error?

options.A: Regional requirements apply only after parliamentary seats have been won
options.B: The initiative requires 5,000 people, whereas 700 suffices for registration
options.C: The initiative group threshold does not replace the requirements for a party's total and regional membership
options.D: State registration is determined solely by the number of congress delegates
options.E: A founding initiative and a registered party are legally identical
